description: Use this when you need a wallet's ETH and major ERC-20 balances on one chain (for all 6 chains with USD totals in one call, see wallet_portfolio). Native ETH and ERC-20 token balances for an address on Ethereum, Base or Arbitrum via public RPC. Defaults to major tokens (USDC, USDT, WETH, DAI/ARB) or pass up to 20 token contracts. Read-only. Returns JSON with: address, chain, chainId, blockNumber, native, tokens, warnings, source. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-balance

address.description: 0x EVM address (EIP-55 checksum validated if mixed case)

include_defaults.description: Also include the default token set when tokens are given; default true

include_zero.description: Include tokens with zero balance; default true

tokens.description: ERC-20 contract addresses (JSON array or comma-separated). Omit for the chain default token set. (comma-separated)

name: evm_balance
title: Evm Balance
